brief.audience: Comfort‑seekers, functional‑fashion fans, and gift shoppers looking for practical Father’s Day ideas.

concepts.hook: Can't decide between Forest Green, Navy or Midnight Black?
concepts.name: Color Dilemma Solved
concepts.script:
Slide 1: Can't decide between Forest Green, Navy or Midnight Black?
Slide 2: Three colors side by side, each with a quick size‑chart callout.
Slide 3: All three are made from 95% cotton, 5% spandex and have six handy pockets.
Slide 4: Swipe up to see the full fit guide and find your confidence.
concepts.tests: Whether a color‑choice hook increases swipe‑through.
concepts.visual_direction: Clean product shots on neutral background, size‑chart overlay, minimal text, brand colors.

concepts.alt_hook: Your new go‑to for every day.
concepts.angle: Position Swoveralls as the ultimate daily wear
concepts.hook: A piece you can actually live in.
concepts.name: Live‑In Comfort
concepts.script:
Slide 1: A piece you can actually live in.
Slide 2: Soft 95% cotton blend feels like sweatpants.
Slide 3: Six pockets keep essentials close, no extra bulk.
Slide 4: Swipe to see why people call it their everyday uniform.
concepts.tests: Impact of lifestyle language on interest.
concepts.visual_direction: Single‑take talking‑head style, natural light, creator holding the product, minimal cuts.

concepts.alt_hook: Wrap comfort into a dad‑approved gift.
concepts.hook: This Father's Day, give a bouquet that fits.
concepts.name: Father’s Day Bouquet
concepts.script:
Slide 1: This Father's Day, give a bouquet that fits.
Slide 2: Rolled Swoveralls in Navy, Midnight Black and Dark Grey tied with a ribbon.
Slide 3: Six pockets for tools, snacks, and love notes.
Slide 4: Swipe to see the unboxing surprise.
concepts.tests: Visual novelty of rolled gift vs standard product shot.
concepts.visual_direction: Stop‑motion of garments being rolled, bright ribbon, close‑up of fabric texture.

concepts.alt_hook: After a long day, he reaches for comfort.
concepts.hook: 12 hours on his feet and he’s still saying I’m fine.
concepts.name: After‑Work Relief
concepts.script:
Slide 1: 12 hours on his feet and he’s still saying I’m fine.
Slide 2: He kicks off his shoes, grabs a coffee, and slides into Swoveralls.
Slide 3: Soft cotton, stretch, and six pockets make the unwind effortless.
Slide 4: Swipe to see why dads choose this after work.
concepts.visual_direction: Lifestyle scene: dad at kitchen table, relaxed, product visible, warm lighting.

concepts.alt_hook: Dad’s puzzled look says it all.
concepts.name: Surprise Unwrap
concepts.script:
Slide 1: Three, two, one… what’s inside?
Slide 2: Dad pulls the wrapping, eyes widen at the sleek Swoveralls.
Slide 3: Close‑up of fabric, pockets, and stretch.
Slide 4: Swipe to watch the full reaction video.
concepts.visual_direction: UGC‑style clip of dad unwrapping, authentic reaction, no staged lines.

concepts.alt_hook: He’s thrilled every time the color changes.
concepts.name: Annual Tradition
concepts.script:
Slide 1: Another year, another Swoveralls surprise.
Slide 2: Dad opens a box, finds a new colour – Midnight Black.
Slide 3: Quick flash of past years’ colours, each with a smile.
Slide 4: Swipe to add this year’s colour to your list.
concepts.tests: Whether recurring gift narrative drives repeat purchase intent.
concepts.visual_direction: Series of short clips showing dad’s reaction over multiple years, consistent branding.

concepts.alt_hook: Skip the novelty, give him something useful.
concepts.hook: Socks, gadgets… none of the stuff dads actually want.
concepts.name: Gifts Dads Actually Want
concepts.script:
Slide 1: Socks, gadgets… none of the stuff dads actually want.
Slide 2: Instead, a sleek Swoveralls in Dark Athletic Grey.
Slide 3: Six pockets, soft cotton, stretch – ready for any task.
Slide 4: Swipe to shop the practical gift.
concepts.visual_direction: Split screen: left side shows unwanted gifts, right side shows Swoveralls, bright contrast.

concepts.alt_hook: He’ll say no, but you know he’ll love this.
concepts.angle: Play on dad’s denial to reveal true desire
concepts.hook: Dad says he doesn’t need anything for Father’s Day.
concepts.name: Dad Says No
concepts.script:
Slide 1: Dad says he doesn’t need anything for Father’s Day.
Slide 2: He opens a box, finds a Swoveralls, smiles.
Slide 3: Close‑up of fabric, pockets, and relaxed fit.
Slide 4: Swipe to see why he’s secretly thrilled.
concepts.visual_direction: POV style, natural lighting, authentic reaction, no scripted lines.

deliverables: 8 carousel ads, each 4 slides, 4:5 ratio, 1080x1350 PNG or JPG.
Optional short video snippets for concepts 1 and 2 (yapper‑style).
done_when: All 8 concept(s) are made, each with its main hook and its alt hook as a separate version to test
Every concept is delivered at its own size: 4:5 1080x1350
Nothing is said or shown that a concept's own Never list rules out
Every on-screen text follows the rules: no banned character or word, nothing the claims gate flagged
Each carousel has its cards in order, the hook on the first card and the call to action on the last
donts: Mention price, discounts, or shipping offers.
Show denim‑style straps or classic overalls silhouette.
Use exclamation points or em dashes.
dos: Use authentic product photos and real‑life settings.
Highlight the six pockets and cotton‑spandex blend.
brief.key_message: Swoveralls blend the feel of sweatpants with smart pockets and sustainable cotton, making them the go‑to piece for everyday comfort and thoughtful gifting.
brief.notes_for_creators: Concept 2 requires John’s sign‑off before any new footage is shot. Avoid any denim‑strap visuals in the first two seconds of any video. Use the brand name Swoveralls, not the word overalls alone. No price or discount language. Follow the size and never guidelines for each carousel.
brief.objective: Drive awareness and consideration for Swoveralls by highlighting comfort, functionality, color options and gifting moments on Meta platforms.
brief.title: Swoveralls Carousel Ad Concepts for Meta
